Privacy

This policy covers Bewie and bewie.atelierindustriel.be, published by Benoit Cazenave. Contact bewie.app@cazenave.fr for privacy questions or deletion requests.

Public player

No account is required. Bewie has no ads, advertising tracking or third-party analytics added by the publisher. Your listening history is not sent to the publisher.

Music and Apple services

Lossless music is downloaded through Apple’s asset delivery service and played locally. Apple Maps may use the internet. App Store, TestFlight, maps and downloads are subject to Apple’s privacy policy. Apple may share diagnostics and TestFlight feedback according to your settings.

Optional location

With your permission, Bewie uses your location to centre the map at launch. Approximate location is enough. Bewie does not track background movements, keep a location history or send your coordinates to the publisher.

Sharing through Messages

When you choose to share a song, Bewie prepares its video locally and adds it and your optional note to a Messages draft. You choose the recipient and send the message yourself. The publisher does not receive the video, note or recipient details through this feature. Apple’s Messages services and your settings govern delivery.

Local data and support requests

Music downloads and playback preferences are stored locally on your device and managed by the operating system. Remove the app to remove its local app data. To request deletion of correspondence you sent to support, contact bewie.app@cazenave.fr. Bewie has no user account or device registration with the publisher.

This website and support

The site adds no advertising trackers or audience-measurement cookies. No language preference is stored. Cloudflare hosts the site and may process technical connection data. Email addresses and messages sent to support are used to handle requests. External services have their own privacy policies.
